title: 第15章 媳妇你要这样我就不客气了第16章 我就算是夫子也是王爷您的狗
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“啊？”
听到沈浪的诉求。
神霄不由的瞪大了眼睛。
完成周公之礼？
岂不是得跟沈浪做那种羞人的事？
这怎么可以？
“看吧，我就知道你并不是真的在乎我，既然这样，咱们还是好聚好散吧！”
说完。
沈浪扭头就走。
神霄见状，心头也是一慌。
忙不迭上前，拦住沈浪道：“相公等等！”
“咱们之间还有什么好说的吗？”
看着沈浪那副失望的神色，不想就这么失去沈浪的神霄，选择撒一个善意的谎言：
“相公，不是我不愿意与你完成周公之礼，只是你现在的身子骨太弱了，若是与我做那事，你那里会冻碎的！”
“啥玩意？”沈浪一头黑线：“娘子，你可以不与我行那周公之礼，但你把我当成傻逼来看待，就有些不尊重人了！”
眼见沈浪生气了，神霄咬了咬贝齿，也是豁出去道：“不相信的话，你将手放上来十秒，试试看！”
我靠，这媳妇奈斯呀！
眼见神霄竟然把自己的大白腿露出来让自己摸，沈浪只觉得自己的呼吸都变的急促了。
他怎么也没有想到，自己只是略施小计，竟然就能换到这种好事。

这让已经很多年没有碰过女人的沈浪，哪里还忍受得了？
“试试就试试！”
这一刻。
随着沈浪缓缓将手伸向神霄的大白腿。
神霄也是闭上了眼睛。
但发颤的身体，以及绯红的脸颊，则彰显着她此刻的慌张。
嘶……哦……
随着沈浪的手放在了神霄的大白腿上。
一股子凉意，也顺着他的手，传遍了四肢百骸。
那种飞一般的感觉，顿时让沈浪觉得神霄这娘们，真欠收拾。
这么美妙的事情，怎么能说会冻坏自己呢？
就在沈浪觉得，神霄是在故意吓唬自己，意图再聊聊感情的时候……
他的手掌，突然传来了一阵刺痛。

"Huh?"
Hear Shen Lang's appeal.
Shen Xiao couldn't help but widen his eyes.
Complete the ceremony of Zhou Gong?
Wouldn't it be necessary to do something embarrassing like that with Shen Lang?
How is this possible?
"Look, I know you don't really care about me. In this case, let's get together and go away!"
Finished.
Shen Lang turned around and left.
When Shen Xiao saw this, he was also panicked.
He hurriedly stepped forward, stopped Shen Lang and said, "Mr. Sir, wait a minute!"
"Is there anything else we can talk about?"
Looking at Shen Lang's disappointed look, he didn't want to lose Shen Xiao just like that, so he chose to tell a white lie:
"My lord, it's not that I don't want to complete the Zhougong ceremony with you, it's just that your body is too weak now. If you do that with me, you will freeze to pieces!"
"What the hell?" Shen Lang said with a black line: "Madam, you don't have to do that Zhougong courtesy with me, but you treat me as a fool, which is a bit disrespectful!"
Seeing that Shen Lang was angry, Shen Xiao bit his teeth and said bravely: "If you don't believe it, put your hand up for ten seconds and try it!"
Damn it, this daughter-in-law is Ness!
Seeing Shen Xiao actually exposing his big white legs for him to touch, Shen Lang felt that his breathing had become faster.
He never thought that with just a little trick, he could get such a good thing.
How could Shen Lang, who had not touched a woman for many years, endure this?
"Just try it!"
This moment.
As Shen Lang slowly stretched out his hand towards Shen Xiao's big white legs.
Shen Xiao also closed his eyes.
But her trembling body and crimson cheeks showed her panic at the moment.
Hiss...oh...
Then Shen Lang placed his hands on Shen Xiao's big white legs.
A chill followed his hand and spread throughout his limbs.
That flying feeling immediately made Shen Lang feel that this girl Shenxiao really needed to be dealt with.
How can such a wonderful thing say that it will freeze oneself?
Just when Shen Lang felt that Shen Xiao was deliberately scaring him, intending to talk about feelings again...
There was a sudden pain in his palm.
